title: Why Stepping on a Toy Brick Hurts So Much
caption:
One tiny toy brick vs your bare foot at 3 a.m.
A cartoon guy tiptoes through a pitch-dark house for a midnight snack, lands on a toy brick, and bursts into tears as a hologram foot maps every pain point.
The brick focuses your whole body weight onto a tiny area (P = F/A), and your soles are packed with nociceptors, so the pain alarm hits maximum.
What's the worst thing you've ever stepped on barefoot?
Share this with a friend whose living room floor is a minefield.
